name: BoardLab Sync
description: Link this board to a BoardLab project: receive BoardLab's changes and findings, send the board back.

actions.name: BoardLab: Link
actions.description: Link this board to a BoardLab project (you confirm the project on boardlab.it)

actions.name: BoardLab: Update board
actions.description: Bring BoardLab's placement and routing into this board: preview, backup, one undo step; your own copper is kept

actions.name: BoardLab: Receive findings
actions.description: Pin BoardLab's open findings as notes on User.Comments

actions.name: BoardLab: Send board
actions.description: Send this board and the schematic saved next to it (all sheets) to the linked BoardLab project
